plan_name: Individual Health Insurance Policy – Platinum & Gold

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room taken. No cap mentioned for Platinum vs Gold — same limit applies to both.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day or actuals, whichever is less.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: Gold plan: Cataract up to 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye (whichever less); Hernia & Hysterectomy up to 25% of SI or ₹1,00,000 (whichever less). Platinum plan has no such sub-limits.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned for base indemnity cover.

initial_waiting.note: Applicable for Gold plan; not explicitly stated as applicable for Platinum but waiting periods section is headed 'Only Applicable for Gold Plan'.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period of 36 months applies only to Gold plan. Platinum plan waiting periods section is not mentioned — no PED waiting stated for Platinum.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Table A diseases (cataract, hernia, hydrocele, calculus, etc.) have 24-month wait; Table B diseases (joint replacement, ARMD, neurodegenerative) have 36-month wait. Applicable only for Gold plan.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18) for all plans. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is defined in the policy but no rate or maximum percentage is stated in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 30 days prior to hospitalisation. Combined pre+post capped at 10% of SI for Gold; no such cap for Platinum.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 60 days after discharge. Combined pre+post capped at 10% of SI for Gold; no such cap for Platinum.

day_care.note: All day care treatments as per definition are covered under in-patient hospitalisation benefit.

domiciliary.note: Covered on reimbursement basis; first 3 days not payable; several diseases excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.); annual limit varies by SI (e.g. ₹45,000 for ₹3L SI, ₹1,00,000 for ₹15L SI).

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered under in-patient hospitalisation at AYUSH hospitals/day care centres as per definitions; no separate sub-limit stated.

organ_donor.note: All hospitalisation expenses for organ donor (excluding cost of organ) covered for transplant to insured person as per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,500 per person per policy period. Payable only if hospitalisation claim is admitted.

modern_treatments.note: 12 specific modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy (hematological), etc. No separate sub-limit stated.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items are listed in Annexure 1 as non-payable. No optional rider for consumables mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly limited to India only; all treatment must be taken in India and claims settled in Indian currency.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, maternity, hearing aids, spectacles/contact lenses, stem cell (except bone marrow), RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric oxygen, external prosthetics/devices post-discharge, vaccinations

optional_riders.display: Daily Cash Allowance (₹500/₹1,000/₹2,000 per day, max ₹5k/₹10k/₹20k per policy period)
